slice: Workflow Studio output bus to built-in comms and evidence polish
intent: Make Workflow Studio feel like the operational source of a cohesive product by routing FD-001 run previews into Messenger, Mail, Community, and Evidence while preserving Oyatie Cloud substrate proof and keeping all actions local-only/unwired.
product_direction: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Added a visible FD-001 Output Bus inside Workflow Studio that binds Run/Validate/Publish preview state to Messenger, Mail, Community, and Evidence routes.
Exposed local product-activity and comms handoff hooks so Workflow Studio can insert drafts into the existing Work Hub instead of feeling like a separate isolated editor.

Run, Validate, Publish, Add block, workflow process actions, and output-route buttons now update route selection, receipt copy, global activity/command shell state, and draft handoff state with no backend execution.
Mail/Community/Messenger routes preserve Workflow Studio source context and insert local drafts; Evidence route opens the audit/resource console with the FD-001/Oyatie Cloud receipt context.
Added responsive production-style CSS for the output bus at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths using existing workflow/Bominal dense-IDE tokens.

before_metrics.issue: Workflow Studio visually referenced Messenger/Mail/Community outputs, but top-level workflow commands did not visibly emit cross-surface drafts or evidence receipts, weakening the cohesive-product narrative.

visual_ralph_verdict.category_match: Bominal-grade dense workflow IDE integrated with cohesive FD-001/Oyatie Cloud command shell
differences: Reference Bominal contains native app chrome and different content density; Oyatie intentionally keeps the shell rail, product activity spine, and local-only proof language.
Output routes are visual/local drafts instead of wired backend sends or deploys by requirement.
suggestions: Continue adding cross-surface receipt trails from Finance, Identity, and Intelligence into the same output bus pattern.
Future slice can add keyboard shortcuts and persistent draft history once real state wiring exists.
visual_ralph_verdict.reasoning: The new bus is visible in the Workflow Studio fold, preserves dense workflow-editor hierarchy, and proves interactions through Browser QA across desktop/tablet/mobile with no overflow or console errors. It directly ties Workflow outputs to Messenger/Mail/Community/Evidence and to FD-001 tenant workloads on Oyatie Cloud.

verification.summary: desktop/tablet/mobile Run→Mail handoff and Run→Evidence route verified; no console errors; no horizontal overflow

local_only_boundary: No workflow execution, mail send, community publish, backend write, deploy, billing, IAM, or cloud mutation is wired; all changes are browser visual state.
